name: Curiosity trace record
description: Capture a single authored exploration step with its question, input, output, status and relation to earlier work.

inputs.question: Concrete question being explored.
inputs.source_item: Supplied text, object, construction or prior note actually used.
inputs.operation: The operation actually performed, if any.
inputs.output: Its actual text, comparison or constructed result.
inputs.prior_record: Earlier record, if a continuation exists.
inputs.interest_reason: The particular surprise or attraction; no usefulness requirement.
inputs.identity: A trace_id unique within the supplied trace set and claim_ids unique across that set; conflicting reuse of an ID is unresolved rather than overwritten.
inputs.evidence_dimensions: Input origin (constructed, supplied source, observed local artifact), operation state (planned, performed, unavailable), per-claim evidence kind (interpretation, direct local measurement, prediction, supplied observation).
inputs.relation: A typed object: type is continues, revises, tests, or contrasts; parent_trace_id and target_claim_ids name the exact prior propositions; null marks a root.

outputs.trace_record: Stable trace and claim identities; exact question, input, performed operation and output; independent evidence dimensions; typed relation; interest reason and uncertainty.
outputs.open_thread: The next unresolved question or a dead-end reason.

success_criteria: Authored results stay distinguishable from source observations.
A planned operation has no observed result attributed to it.
A dead end can retain interest without fabricated utility.
steps: Record the selected question and its interest reason.
Record the exact supplied or constructed input.
State the performed operation and preserve the resulting output.

Record input origin, whether the operation was performed, and the evidence kind of each output claim separately. A performed fictional comparison is constructed input plus performed operation plus interpretive output.

Resolve the parent trace and every target claim. Record continues, revises, tests, or contrasts as appropriate. A missing parent, missing target, cycle or conflicting ID remains a provenance gap; a contrast alone does not revoke its parent.
Record the open question or the reason this thread stopped.
verification: Trace each claimed observation to the supplied input or actual output.
Check that trace and claim IDs are unique and that every non-root relation refers to an existing parent and claim owned by that parent.
Check that a planned test is not described as completed.
A revision names the proposition it corrects, not the entire prior thread by default.
A returned parent chain terminates at a known root without cycling; a missing target claim is distinct from a missing parent trace.
A direct character count and an interpretive meaning claim have different evidence kinds even in one trace.
complexity: simple record creation with moderate status interpretation.
dependencies: An actual exploration product or explicitly planned step.
reuse_potential: Creative comparisons, thought experiments, interpretation exercises and later source studies.
when_to_use: A local exploration has a concrete input and output to preserve.
A proposed operation should remain visibly unperformed.

examples.input: Same question label placed at a platform and a drawing.
examples.output: Two constructed interpretations; no audience effect claimed.

examples.input: A causal experiment is proposed but not performed.
examples.output: Planned status; predicted result is a prediction.

examples.input: An explored metaphor produced no distinct comparison.
examples.output: Dead-end reason retained; interest can remain.

examples.input: A second note revises an earlier question.
examples.output: New trace linked to the earlier note and its changed question.

failure_modes.prevention: Keep interest reason separate from evidence status.

failure_modes.failure: Planned operation narrated in past tense
failure_modes.consequence: An unperformed test becomes a result.
A later question loses its derivation.
failure_modes.prevention: Carry a resolvable prior link or mark it unavailable.

failure_modes.failure: No utility is coded as no value
failure_modes.prevention: Retain the stated interest reason without promised benefit.

gosm_integration.after: Actual exploration operation or explicit plan.
gosm_integration.external_gate: Human outcome claims need observations beyond a constructed trace.

revision_origin.reason: ITERATE findings T01–T12; not a modification to an archived Reasoningtool original.
